statement: Supplemental complementary-remainder supporting proofs; actual signed single and large-angle pair components

passages.correspondence: Exact signed single/pair decomposition of the actual Hessian and actual Gaussian fourth directional derivative. Both repeated slots are fixed before averaging. Rectangular factor adapter preserves the source rank dimension.

∀ {p : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ),
  (∀ (j : Fin p), (A * A.transpose) j j = 1) →
    ∀ (x Y W : RectangleCLT.Vector p),
      RectangleCLT.Companion.restorationHessian s x Y W =
        -(1 / s.bandwidth) *
            ∑ f,
              RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot f Y * RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot f W *
                RectangleCLTArxivV1.capOriginalSingleDerivative s A x f +
          1 / s.bandwidth ^ 2 *
            ∑ f,
              ∑ g,
                RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorTupleWeight s ![f, g] x *
                  RectangleCLTArxivV1.capOriginalPairCoefficient A f g Y W

∀ {p : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ),
  (∀ (j : Fin p), (A * A.transpose) j j = 1) →
    ∀ (x Z Y W : RectangleCLT.Vector p) {σ : ℝ},
      σ ≠ 0 →
        s.convolutionFourthTensor (RectangleCLT.gaussianLaw (σ • A)) x (A.mulVec Z) (A.mulVec Z) Y W =
          -(1 / (s.bandwidth * σ ^ 3)) *
              ∑ f,
                RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot f Y * RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot f W *
                  ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector p),
                    RectangleCLTArxivV1.capThirdHermiteScore (RectangleCLTArxivV1.capFactorNormal A f) Z g *
                      RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorTupleWeight s ![f]
                        ((σ • A).mulVec g + x) ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian p +
            1 / (s.bandwidth ^ 2 * σ ^ 2) *
              ∑ f,
                ∑ g,
                  RectangleCLTArxivV1.capOriginalPairCoefficient A f g Y W *
                    ∫ (z : RectangleCLT.Vector p),
                      RectangleCLT.Companion.repeatedDirectionScore z Z *
                        RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorTupleWeight s ![f, g]
                          ((σ • A).mulVec z + x) ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian p

∀ {p r : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ),
  (∀ (j : Fin p), (A * A.transpose) j j = 1) →
    ∀ (x Y W : RectangleCLT.Vector p),
      RectangleCLT.Companion.restorationHessian s x Y W =
        -(1 / s.bandwidth) *
            ∑ f,
              RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot f Y * RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot f W *
                RectangleCLTArxivV1.capRectangularSingleDerivative s A x f +
          1 / s.bandwidth ^ 2 *
            ∑ f,
              ∑ g,
                RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorTupleWeight s ![f, g] x *
                  RectangleCLTArxivV1.capRectangularPairCoefficient A f g Y W

∀ {p r : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ),
  (∀ (j : Fin p), (A * A.transpose) j j = 1) →
    ∀ (x : RectangleCLT.Vector p) (Z : RectangleCLT.Vector r) (Y W : RectangleCLT.Vector p) {σ : ℝ},
      σ ≠ 0 →
        ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
            RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.restorationFourthDerivative s ((σ • A).mulVec g + x) (A.mulVec Z) Y
              W ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r =
          -(1 / (s.bandwidth * σ ^ 3)) *
              ∑ f,
                RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot f Y * RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot f W *
                  ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                    RectangleCLTArxivV1.capThirdHermiteScore (RectangleCLTArxivV1.capRectangularFactorNormal A f) Z g *
                      RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorTupleWeight s ![f]
                        ((σ • A).mulVec g + x) ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r +
            1 / (s.bandwidth ^ 2 * σ ^ 2) *
              ∑ f,
                ∑ g,
                  RectangleCLTArxivV1.capRectangularPairCoefficient A f g Y W *
                    ∫ (z : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                      RectangleCLT.Companion.repeatedDirectionScore z Z *
                        RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorTupleWeight s ![f, g]
                          ((σ • A).mulVec z + x) ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r

passages.correspondence: Actual angular direction is unit. Aggregate copy expectation is bounded by4K(1−|ρ|), with no independence between direction slots; the original coordinate envelope gives4δ².
passages.proof_adaptation: For the common quadratic budget K, use 2|ab|≤a²+b² in place of the displayed Cauchy–Schwarz inequality. This proves the same required bound and applies to dependent old/fresh slot choices.

∀ {r : ℕ} (u v z w : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  |u ⬝ᵥ v| < 1 →
    RectangleCLTArxivV1.capPairCoefficient u v z w =
      RectangleCLTArxivV1.capSign (u ⬝ᵥ v) * (1 - |u ⬝ᵥ v|) *
        (u ⬝ᵥ z * u ⬝ᵥ w + v ⬝ᵥ z * v ⬝ᵥ w -
          2 * RectangleCLTArxivV1.capAngularDirection u v ⬝ᵥ z * RectangleCLTArxivV1.capAngularDirection u v ⬝ᵥ w)

∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {n r : ℕ} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  (Z W : Fin n → Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  (∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable (Z i)) →
    (∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable (W i)) →
      (∀ (i : Fin n) (j k : Fin r), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Z i ω j * Z i ω k) μ) →
        (∀ (i : Fin n) (j k : Fin r), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => W i ω j * W i ω k) μ) →
          ∀ {K : ℝ},
            (∀ (e : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                ∑ i, ∫ (ω : Ω), RectangleCLT.faceDot e (Z i ω) ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ K * RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq e) →
              (∀ (e : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                  ∑ i, ∫ (ω : Ω), RectangleCLT.faceDot e (W i ω) ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ K * RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq e) →
                ∀ (u v : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq u = 1 →
                    RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq v = 1 →
                      |u ⬝ᵥ v| < 1 →
                        ∑ i, ∫ (ω : Ω), |RectangleCLTArxivV1.capPairCoefficient u v (Z i ω) (W i ω)| ∂μ ≤
                          4 * K * (1 - |u ⬝ᵥ v|)

∀ {p r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) (f g : RectangleCLT.Face p) (Y W : RectangleCLT.Vector p) {δ : ℝ},
  0 ≤ δ →
    |RectangleCLT.faceDot (RectangleCLTArxivV1.capRectangularFactorNormal A f)
            (RectangleCLTArxivV1.capRectangularFactorNormal A g)| ≤
        1 →
      |RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot f Y| ≤ δ →
        |RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot g Y| ≤ δ →
          |RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot f W| ≤ δ →
            |RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot g W| ≤ δ →
              |RectangleCLTArxivV1.capRectangularPairCoefficient A f g Y W| ≤ 4 * δ ^ 2

∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {p r n : ℕ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {ξ : Fin n → Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p} {δ : ℝ},
  RectangleCLT.BoundedIndependentHypotheses μ ξ δ →
    ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) (a b : Bool) (f g : RectangleCLT.Face p),
      |RectangleCLT.faceDot (RectangleCLTArxivV1.capRectangularFactorNormal A f)
              (RectangleCLTArxivV1.capRectangularFactorNormal A g)| ≤
          1 →
        ∀ (i : Fin n),
          ∀ᵐ (z : Ω × Ω) ∂μ.prod μ,
            |RectangleCLTArxivV1.capRectangularPairCoefficient A f g (RectangleCLTArxivV1.capOriginalCopy ξ a i z)
                  (RectangleCLTArxivV1.capOriginalCopy ξ b i z)| ≤
              4 * δ ^ 2

passages.correspondence: Actual second directional derivative equals W/h² times squared log derivative minus covariance. The pointwise bound is28δ²/h² times W, and a shift costs exp(5R/h).

    (RectangleCLTArxivV1.capSoftFaceSecond s S y (RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.line x y t)) t

∀ {p : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (S : Finset (RectangleCLT.Face p)),

    ∀ (x y : RectangleCLT.Vector p) {δ : ℝ},
      0 ≤ δ →
        ‖y‖ ≤ δ → |RectangleCLTArxivV1.capSoftFaceSecond s S y x| ≤ 28 * δ ^ 2 / s.bandwidth ^ 2 * s.softFaceWeight S x

∀ {p : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (S : Finset (RectangleCLT.Face p)),
  S.card ≤ 2 →
    ∀ (x y : RectangleCLT.Vector p) {δ R : ℝ},
      0 ≤ δ →
        ‖y‖ ≤ δ →
          ∀ {v : RectangleCLT.Vector p},

passages.correspondence: The actual signed H3 score retains both derivative corrections with coefficient2. Gaussian polynomial integrability is proved before scalar Stein. The rectangular adapter treats Gaussian dimension independently of ambient dimension.

∀ {r : ℕ} (u Z g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  RectangleCLTArxivV1.capThirdHermiteScore u Z g =
    RectangleCLT.matrixQuadratic (RectangleCLTArxivV1.capThirdHermiteMatrix u g) Z

∀ {p : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) (S : Finset (RectangleCLT.Face p))
  (x u Z : RectangleCLT.Vector p),
  ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector p),
      RectangleCLTArxivV1.capThirdHermiteScore u Z g *
        s.softFaceWeight S (A.mulVec g + x) ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian p =
    ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector p),
      RectangleCLT.Companion.repeatedDirectionScore g Z *
        s.softFaceDirectional S (A.mulVec u) (A.mulVec g + x) ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian p

∀ {r : ℕ} (u Z : RectangleCLT.Vector r) (F : RectangleCLT.Vector r → ℝ) (D : Fin r → RectangleCLT.Vector r → ℝ),
  Measurable F →
    (∀ (j : Fin r), Measurable (D j)) →
      (∃ C, ∀ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r), |F g| ≤ C) →
        (∀ (j : Fin r), ∃ C, ∀ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r), |D j g| ≤ C) →
          (∀ (j : Fin r) (g : Fin r → ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun t => F (Function.update g j t)) (D j g) (g j)) →
            ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                RectangleCLTArxivV1.capThirdHermiteScore u Z g * F g ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r =
              ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                RectangleCLT.Companion.repeatedDirectionScore g Z * ∑ j, u j * D j g ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r

∀ {p r : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) (S : Finset (RectangleCLT.Face p))
  (x : RectangleCLT.Vector p) (u Z : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
      RectangleCLTArxivV1.capThirdHermiteScore u Z g *
        s.softFaceWeight S (A.mulVec g + x) ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r =
    ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
      RectangleCLT.Companion.repeatedDirectionScore g Z *
        s.softFaceDirectional S (A.mulVec u) (A.mulVec g + x) ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r

passages.correspondence: Expand the exact translated selector series before taking absolute traces. Copy averaging bounds the signed coefficient matrix by its true quadratic budget. Extra selector tuples sum to at most1. The whole series keeps the original weight Wα and has numerical bound2·3^k bK under R/h≤log(3/2).
passages.proof_adaptation: A generic symmetric-matrix score abstraction proves the same restoration estimate for H2 and H3. Null-set clipping replaces AE envelopes only on null sets and preserves actual integrals.

∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {p r n k : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p)
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) (Z : Fin n → Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector r) (c : Fin n → Ω → ℝ)
  (v : Fin n → Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p) (α : Fin k → RectangleCLT.Face p),
  (∀ (i : Fin n) (j l : Fin r), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Z i ω j * Z i ω l) μ) →
    (∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable (c i)) →
      (∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable (v i)) →
        ∀ {b K R : ℝ},
          0 ≤ b →
            0 ≤ K →
              0 ≤ R →
                (∀ (i : Fin n) (ω : Ω), |c i ω| ≤ b) →
                  (∀ (i : Fin n) (ω : Ω), ‖v i ω‖ ≤ R) →
                    (∀ (y : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                        ∑ i, ∫ (ω : Ω), RectangleCLT.faceDot y (Z i ω) ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ K * RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq y) →
                      ∀ (x : RectangleCLT.Vector p) (u g : RectangleCLT.Vector r) (ℓ : ℕ),
                        |∑ i,
                              ∫ (ω : Ω),
                                c i ω * RectangleCLTArxivV1.capThirdHermiteScore u (Z i ω) g *
                                  RectangleCLT.Companion.restorationSeriesTerm s α x (v i ω) ℓ ∂μ| ≤
                          ↑((k + ℓ).choose ℓ) * (Real.exp (R / s.bandwidth) - 1) ^ ℓ *
                              (b * K * Real.exp (↑k * R / s.bandwidth) *
                                RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.symmetricNuclearNorm
                                  (RectangleCLTArxivV1.capThirdHermiteMatrix u g)) *
                            RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorTupleWeight s α x

∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {p r n k : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p)
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) (Z : Fin n → Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector r) (c : Fin n → Ω → ℝ)
  (v : Fin n → Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p) (α : Fin k → RectangleCLT.Face p),
  (∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable (Z i)) →
    (∀ (i : Fin n) (j l : Fin r), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Z i ω j * Z i ω l) μ) →
      (∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable (c i)) →
        (∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable (v i)) →
          ∀ {b K R : ℝ},
            0 ≤ b →
              0 ≤ K →
                0 ≤ R →
                  (∀ (i : Fin n), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, |c i ω| ≤ b) →
                    (∀ (i : Fin n), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, ‖v i ω‖ ≤ R) →
                      (∀ (y : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                          ∑ i, ∫ (ω : Ω), RectangleCLT.faceDot y (Z i ω) ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ K * RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq y) →
                        R / s.bandwidth ≤ Real.log (3 / 2) →
                          ∀ (x : RectangleCLT.Vector p) (u g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                            |∑ i,
                                  ∫ (ω : Ω),
                                    c i ω * RectangleCLTArxivV1.capThirdHermiteScore u (Z i ω) g *
                                      RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorTupleWeight s α (x + v i ω) ∂μ| ≤
                              2 * 3 ^ k * b * K *
                                  RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.symmetricNuclearNorm
                                    (RectangleCLTArxivV1.capThirdHermiteMatrix u g) *
                                RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorTupleWeight s α x

∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {p r n k : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p)
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ)
  (V : Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p),
  Measurable V →
    ∀ (u : RectangleCLT.Vector r) (Z : Fin n → Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector r),
      (∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable (Z i)) →
        (∀ (i : Fin n) (j l : Fin r), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Z i ω j * Z i ω l) μ) →
          ∀ (c : Fin n → (Fin k → RectangleCLT.Face p) → Ω → ℝ),
            (∀ (i : Fin n) (α : Fin k → RectangleCLT.Face p), Measurable (c i α)) →
              ∀ (v : Fin n → Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p),
                (∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable (v i)) →
                  ∀ {b R : ℝ},
                    0 ≤ b →
                      0 ≤ R →
                        (∀ (i : Fin n) (α : Fin k → RectangleCLT.Face p), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, |c i α ω| ≤ b) →
                          (∀ (i : Fin n), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, ‖v i ω‖ ≤ R) →
                            R / s.bandwidth < Real.log 2 →
                              MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                  (fun z =>
                                    ∑ i,
                                      ∑ α,
                                        c i α z.1 * RectangleCLTArxivV1.capThirdHermiteScore u (Z i z.1) z.2 *
                                          RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorTupleWeight s α
                                            (A.mulVec z.2 + V z.1 + v i z.1))
                                  (μ.prod (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r)) ∧
                                (∀ (ℓ : ℕ),
                                    MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                      (fun z =>
                                        ∑ i,
                                          ∑ α,
                                            c i α z.1 * RectangleCLTArxivV1.capThirdHermiteScore u (Z i z.1) z.2 *
                                              RectangleCLT.Companion.restorationSeriesTerm s α (A.mulVec z.2 + V z.1)
                                                (v i z.1) ℓ)
                                      (μ.prod (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r))) ∧
                                  HasSum
                                    (fun ℓ =>
                                      ∫ (z : Ω × RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                                        ∑ i,
                                          ∑ α,
                                            c i α z.1 * RectangleCLTArxivV1.capThirdHermiteScore u (Z i z.1) z.2 *
                                              RectangleCLT.Companion.restorationSeriesTerm s α (A.mulVec z.2 + V z.1)
                                                (v i z.1) ℓ ∂μ.prod (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r))
                                    (∫ (z : Ω × RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                                      ∑ i,
                                        ∑ α,
                                          c i α z.1 * RectangleCLTArxivV1.capThirdHermiteScore u (Z i z.1) z.2 *
                                            RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorTupleWeight s α
                                              (A.mulVec z.2 + V z.1 +
                                                v i z.1) ∂μ.prod (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r))

∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {p r n k : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p)
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) (Z : Fin n → Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector r) (c : Fin n → Ω → ℝ)
  (v : Fin n → Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p) (α : Fin k → RectangleCLT.Face p),

      (∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable (v i)) →

                                      RectangleCLT.Companion.restorationSeriesTerm s α x (v i ω) ℓ ∂μ| ≤

                                    RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.symmetricNuclearNorm M) *

∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {p r n k : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p)
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) (Z : Fin n → Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector r) (c : Fin n → Ω → ℝ)

passages.correspondence: After signed copy averaging, integrate the original positive weight over the unconditional base with the other Gaussian fixed. Original signed-coordinate FaceSmoother weights, including missing faces, are bounded by the proved raw projected-data G2 masses. Intermediate mass premises occur only in explicitly intermediate lemmas and are discharged in native raw endpoints.

∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {Ξ : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace Ξ] {p r n k : ℕ}
  (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [inst_2 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
  (κ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ξ) [inst_3 : MeasureTheory.SFinite κ] (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ)
  (V : Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p),
  Measurable V →
    ∀ (Z : Fin n → Ξ → RectangleCLT.Vector r),
      (∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable (Z i)) →
        (∀ (i : Fin n) (j l : Fin r), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ξ => Z i ξ j * Z i ξ l) κ) →

passages.correspondence: Actual independent copies are built from the original bounded family; covariance whitening supplies budget≤I even when the covariance is singular. Old/fresh copy choices and reconstruction supply all coefficient envelopes. The normalized one-face term is bounded by480 exp(1/2)√(π/a)δ²r/σ³; the large-angle pair term by9216 exp1 π³δ²r/(νσ²). Native projected-base covariance and shift identities are actual model inputs, not remainder estimates.
